text:
sara_ae: Heads up  we have a proof-of-concept with HelixCare. They want SSE streaming (python), in-stream function/tool calls to their case API, and guaranteed JSON schema output. They've asked for EU data residency and have a hard spend ceiling ~12k/mo. Need quick presales runbook + sample snippets.

 tom_se: I can own the integration checklist. Quick Qs: are tool calls expected to be sync webhook POSTs? And do they want retries/at-least-once semantics?

 sara_ae: Yes sync POSTs to their internal case endpoint. Retries are fine but they want idempotency keys. SLA target: 95p latency <300ms.

 jess_devex: I'll assemble a tiny sample app. For debugging, enable SDK trace env var and run sample in live-debug mode. Example snippet: 
 ```
 # python
 from redwood_sdk import Client
 import os
 c = Client(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'), enable_trace=True)
 with c.stream(model='redwood-compact', transport='sse') as s:
   for msg in s:
     print(msg)
 ```
 Use `response_format=jsonschema` and `top_level_schema` to enforce structured output. Add a `--proxy-eu` flag to route traffic to eu-west for residency tests.

 claire_sre: For EU residency, recommend Dedicated in eu-west or Private. Hosted EU nodes available but audit/KMS options limited. Cost note: hosted w/ routing might hit token egress; Dedicated small pool estimate ~9k-11k/mo which aligns with their ceiling if we optimize model choice.

 tom_se: Implementation notes: 1) Emit tool calls as an explicit `tool_invocation` event with {call_id, idempotency_key, payload} so SRE/tracing can correlate. 2) Keep batching conservative during POC, e.g., `batching.window_ms=5` and `max_batch_tokens` ~= 80 to avoid cost spikes. 3) For schema validation in-stream, run a lightweight validator on each event and surface failures as telemetry.

 infra-bot: Ticket created: POC-HELI-2026-77 "HelixCare SSE POC - EU residency + tool-calls + security checklist" assigned to @jess_devex, @tom_se.

 jess_devex: ETA for sample app + short security checklist: EOD tomorrow. Checklist will include data flows diagram, KMS/HSM usage, retention defaults, access controls, audit log links, and SOC2 artifacts.

 sara_ae: Great. Please include a one-paragraph reply for the customer security questionnaire summarizing controls and a short cost table: hosted vs dedicated vs private assumptions. I'll attach to the RFP.

 tom_se: Also adding a quick runbook item: during POC set `max_tokens` low and `concurrency.limit` to a safe number, plus an alert at $1k/day spend so legal/finance won't get surprised.

 sara_ae: Thanks team :thumbsup:
